english.notes:
(i) In addition to or in substitution for the imposition of a fine, the court may order the removal of the notice within a period being not less than four days
(ii) See Section 1(1) for "access land".
(iii) See offence wording H3832 for offence in relation to failure to comply with an order to remove such a notice
